P_0x006CCE: A pilot of Excellence Rescue. Responsible and hot-blooded, he doesn't sweat small stuff. With twin sister Fiona he founded "L&E Corp," a repair/rescue firm, and serves as its president.
P_0x006E34: Raul's twin sister: strong-willed and cheerful. More level-headed than Raul, often mistaken for the elder sibling. Driven and stubborn once set on something. Handles sales and chores at "L&E Corporation," but is its real manager.
P_0x006FFD: A Technity Paides (artificial life form) made by Deuminas. After the <Shura Revolt>, taken in by Raul and Fiona, becoming family. Works as assistant at "L&E Corp." Reserved and quiet.
P_0x007170: A high schooler in Asakusa, Japan, grandson of inventor Kisaburo Azuma. Seems blunt but has a strong sense of justice. Quick to fight, loves festivals, spends freely, dotes on his sister. Wears Roar Armor as Fighter Roar.
P_0x0072E5: Kouta's little sister: bright, energetic, capable at every chore, popular at school. Always worried about Kouta, though she nags him to his face. Thrifty, unlike her spendthrift brother. Wears Emmy Armor as Fighter Emmy.
P_0x007491: A held-back senior at Bannanmu High in Osaka, known in Kansai as a top delinquent. Fights fiercely, solves things with force, but is weak to cute girls. Grandpa moved Osaka to Tokyo, back to Osaka when Michiru was 10, so he speaks odd Kansai dialect.
